C-PLAN-COMPOSITION-371.IntentSummary: Extend the current plan/source-row/calendar/template contracts, with one owner per scope and an independent integration audit. Prospective scope clarifications before implementation: body-based template preview reads require central source ACL inheritance; ordinary intake must proceed during one optional model request; content-based upload retries must reject another workspace, inaccessible sources and different content under the same key; the existing quality job must run the new focused browser scenario conditionally because the local Chromium sandbox is unavailable. The accepted purpose, schema and security model are unchanged; no release workflow, dependencies or new CI workflow are introduced.
